_comment: The archive's school quarters (operator, 2026-11-17): the 2025-26 year as one bucket, summer 2026, then 2026-27's marking periods from the CCPS calendar. A record is filed in the quarter whose [start, end] holds its filed_on date. 'end: null' means not yet known (add it from the district calendar before the quarter ends). Read by tools/archive/; the generated indexes take each quarter's title, plan and summary from here.

quarters.title: 2025-26 school year
quarters.summary: LeaderHub as a single HTML file (its handoff, WIP log, README and two grading snapshots), and the RTP's cold-start orientation.

quarters.title: Summer 2026
quarters.summary: Planning before the school year: the RTP's current-state draft and zone spec, the Drive audit's first assumptions deep dive, and the August codebase review.

quarters.title: 2026-27, 1st quarter
quarters.summary: The build and launch: kos-personal's pipeline repaired and the RTP moved to a Claude Project (10-06); CAS live with students (first submissions 10-16); the dashboards, lesson parts, the nightly rollout and the turn-in plan; LeaderHub to an Apps Script web app. Most of the archive is here.

quarters.title: 2026-27, 2nd quarter
quarters.summary: In progress: the handoffs of 10-31, 11-01 and 11-08 so far; the history logs' entries from 10-29 are still live.

quarters.title: 2026-27, 4th quarter
quarters.summary: Not started. Ends with the last day of school.
